sections.title: Global Business through the Social Sciences
sections.description: This required core course introduces Lauder students to the fundamentals of comparative analysis through exploration of leading debates in the fields of comparative politics, political economy, and economic development. In addition to knowledge acquisition, students will enhance their capacity for independent research on cross-national, country, and region-focused topics.
